messages.subject: Internal Error 7
parts:
Does anyone have experiencing troubleshooting Internal Error 7? I could
find nothing in the listserv archives nor Bugzilla. The error occurs while
running analyses and states:



Unexpected error in Distance Numerical Server.

Source: D6NSvr.NServerItem.RunItem

Internal Error number: 7.

Internal Error description: =E2=80=9COut of memory=E2=80=9D.

(Error raised from Distance.ModGlobal.GenericRunBrowserItem)

(Error source: D6NSvr.NServerItem.RunItem)

(Error number: -2147211505)



Other details:

Distance 6.2 on a new PC laptop, Windows 8, 8GB RAM

Using CDS engine

No other known problems with laptop

Re-downloaded and reinstalled Distance with no effect

The same project and analyses run fine on another new laptop (although the
program does prompt Windows 7 to advise turning off the Aero display theme)



Any insights appreciated,

Greg Levandoski
Rocky Mountain Bird Observatory
International Program
